audit.whatIsWrong: Packet defect: 'NO cooldown-sequencing advice anywhere.' Correct — neither layer contains a single number or a single 'wait for X before Y' line.
audit.why: The sequencing here is unusually clean because Yorick's ghouls are gated on one ability. Mourning Mist (E) marks the target, and Riot's text says 'Summoned units gain move speed when moving towards marked targets' — so the Mist Walkers only actually converge once E lands. E is 12/11/10/9/8s. A dodged Mourning Mist therefore buys a full 12 seconds at rank 1 in which the ghoul swarm is slow and harmless, and that is the window to commit. Dark Procession is 20s and Eulogy of the Isles is 160s at rank 1.
audit.corrected: Dodge Mourning Mist and the ghouls lose their speed-up for 12s — that is your engage window, not "when W is down".
sources: champ-data/_kits/yorick.json (Mourning Mist CD 12/11/10/9/8; Dark Procession CD 20/18/16/14/12; Eulogy of the Isles CD 160/130/100)

audit.whatIsWrong: Dark Procession (W) is treated as an inescapable cage in both layers ('Avoid his Cage so you're not trapped', 'Traps you for ghouls').
audit.why: Riot's text: 'Yorick summons a destructible wall at target location that will block enemy movement.' Destructible is the operative word — the wall has health and can simply be broken. Zac in particular has Unstable Matter on a flat 5s cooldown hitting everything within 350 units, so he is well equipped to chew a segment down rather than sit inside it waiting for ghouls.
audit.corrected: The cage is destructible — break a segment rather than waiting it out. It is 20s at rank 1.

audit.whatIsWrong: Neither layer explains that trading with Yorick is what builds his ghoul army in the first place.
audit.why: Last Rites (Q): 'If the target is a champion or large monster or if the target dies, a grave will be dug.' Graves are what Shepherd of Souls (P) raises Mist Walkers from. So every Q Yorick lands on Zac directly manufactures the swarm that then beats Zac. That converts vague 'don't trade' advice into a mechanical reason, and Q is a 6s auto-attack reset that also heals him.
audit.corrected: Every Last Rites he lands on you digs a grave, and graves are his ghouls — refusing the trade starves the swarm.

audit.whatIsWrong: Grievous Wounds is never mentioned despite Last Rites healing him on a 6s auto-reset.
audit.why: _missing-interactions.json flags zac vs yorick as needs-antiheal on Last Rites (Q). Yorick heals on a 6s cadence throughout the lane and Zac has no burst to outpace it, so anti-heal is the item that makes the grind viable.
audit.corrected: Grievous Wounds by first item — his Q heal is on a 6s cadence and you have no burst to outrun it.

edits.before: Yorick's Last Rites (Q) heal plus Mourning Mist (E) slow-and-mark lets him command his Mist Walkers onto you; with ghouls up his sustained trade damage and self-heal beat your blob at every level.
edits.after: Mourning Mist (E) is the trigger — his Mist Walkers only speed at you once the mark lands, so a dodged E buys 12s of harmless ghouls. Last Rites (Q) heals on a 6s reset and digs his next ghoul's grave.

edits.before: Eulogy of the Isles (R) Maiden turns a side-lane fight into a 2v1 — the Maiden plus ghouls shred you, and even your Elastic Slingshot engage gets ground down before you can burst him.
edits.after: Eulogy of the Isles (R) Maiden turns a side-lane fight into a 2v1 — but it is 160s at rank 1, the longest cooldown in the lane. Do not contest the side lane while it lives.

edits.before: After first item Yorick's Cage (W) can trap you in his ghoul swarm; his split-push pressure with Maiden forces your team to answer, and 1v1 you simply lose to the ghoul DPS.
edits.after: After first item his Cage (W) walls you into the swarm — but it is destructible, so break a segment with W ticks instead of waiting inside it. 1v1 you still lose to the ghoul DPS.

edits.before: Yorick owns the early game: Last Rites (Q) heals him through your poke, Mourning Mist (E) slows and marks you so his Mist Walkers pile on, and once he has a few ghouls up his sustained damage plus self-heal make any trade lopsided — just soak farm and body-block ghouls where you can.
edits.after: Yorick owns the early game: Last Rites (Q) heals him through your poke on a 6s reset and every Q he lands on you digs a grave, which is literally where his next Mist Walker comes from. Mourning Mist (E) is what sends them at you — dodge it and the swarm crawls for 12s.

edits.before: Levels 3-6 stay firmly his — his Cage (W) can wall you into the swarm, and at 6 Eulogy of the Isles (R) adds the Maiden, turning the side lane into a 2v1 you can't win even with your E engage, so play safe and call your jungler rather than dueling.
edits.after: Levels 3-6 stay firmly his, but the sequencing is fixed: wait for Mourning Mist (E, 12s) to miss before you commit, and break his Cage rather than sitting in it — it is destructible. At 6 the Maiden makes it a 2v1, so call your jungler instead of dueling.

edits.before: At 2 his Mist Walkers start piling on with E-mark, tilting trades his way.
edits.after: At 2 his E-mark is what sends the Mist Walkers — dodge it and they crawl.

edits.before: Levels 4-5 his Cage (W) can trap you in the swarm for a lopsided extended trade.
edits.after: Levels 4-5 his Cage walls you in, though it is destructible if you break it.

edits.before: Clear or body-block his Mist Walkers to cut his trade damage
edits.after: Dodge Mourning Mist (12s) — unmarked, the ghouls crawl

edits.before: Avoid his Cage (W) so you're not trapped in the ghoul swarm
edits.after: Break his Cage (W) down rather than sitting inside of it

edits.before: - Yorick Dark Procession: matchup-defining — Traps you for ghouls. E out of it. Track it before every engage. - Your committal tool: never spend it on chip. - Your ultimate: the win condition — kill windows only.
edits.after: - Yorick Mourning Mist: 12s at rank 1, and it is what speeds the ghouls at you — dodge it and commit. - Dark Procession: 20s, destructible, so break it. - Eulogy of the Isles: 160s — concede the side lane to Maiden.

edits.before: The lane-control window: trade around Dark Procession's cooldown and bank small leads. If ahead, freeze and deny; if behind, farm safe.
edits.after: The lane-control window: commit in the 12s after a missed Mourning Mist, not when his Cage is down. If behind, just farm safe.

edits.before: Elastic Slingshot from fog + R bounces win every river fight. Reassess every all-in at 6 — Yorick's ultimate changes the math too.
edits.after: Eulogy of the Isles is 160s at rank 1 — the longest cooldown here. Concede the side lane while Maiden lives, take it back after.

edits.before: E-knock him off Maiden — sustain through ghouls. Zac wins the Dark Procession cooldown windows.
edits.after: Dodge Mourning Mist and the ghouls crawl. Zac wins the 12s window after a missed E-mark.

edits.before: Trade strictly around Dark Procession: when it is down, run your full pattern; when it is up, give nothing. If ahead, freeze and starve him.
edits.after: Trade strictly around Mourning Mist: a missed E means 12s of slow ghouls and that is your pattern window. If ahead, freeze and starve him.

notes: Addresses the packet's 'NO cooldown-sequencing advice anywhere' defect directly, and in doing so retargets the matchup: both layers told you to track Dark Procession (W), but the ability that actually gates the ghoul swarm is Mourning Mist (E) — Riot's text says summoned units gain move speed toward MARKED targets, so an unmarked Zac is not swarmed. The full layer's focus is set to Dark Procession, so dosFull and report still point at W after my edits; retargeting focus to Mourning Mist (E) and regenerating would align them. Packet suspectName ('Let's Bounce' in late) is a FALSE POSITIVE — the file writes "Let's Bounce!" and the detector strips the '!'.
